blocks.prompt: 5 (i) If \(z_1 = 7\left(\cos\frac{23\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{23\pi}{12}\right)\) and \(z_2 = 11\left(\cos\frac{11\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{11\pi}{12}\right)\), find \(z_1 + z_2\) and express the result in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh Sawal 4 jaisa hi hai, bas numbers naye hain. Jama ke liye pehle dono numbers ko \(x + iy\) mein badalna parta hai. Plan: \(z_1\) aur \(z_2\) ka rectangular form, phir real se real aur imaginary se imaginary jama. Aakhir mein hum ek khaas baat use karenge: yeh dono numbers bilkul ulti directions mein hain, jis se exact check ho jata hai.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(z_1 = 7\,\text{cis}\,\frac{23\pi}{12}\), \(z_2 = 11\,\text{cis}\,\frac{11\pi}{12}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(z_1 + z_2\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): rectangular form mein badal kar jama.

\(z_1\) aur \(z_2\) ko rectangular form mein likhein
\(\frac{23\pi}{12} = 345^{\circ}\) (fourth quadrant: cos plus, sin minus) aur \(\frac{11\pi}{12} = 165^{\circ}\) (second quadrant: cos minus, sin plus); dono ka reference angle \(15^{\circ}\) hai.
\[z_1 = 7(\cos 345^{\circ} + i\sin 345^{\circ})\]
\[z_1 = 7(0.9659 - 0.2588i)\]
\[z_1 \approx 6.761 - 1.812i\]
\[z_2 = 11(\cos 165^{\circ} + i\sin 165^{\circ})\]
\[z_2 = 11(-0.9659 + 0.2588i)\]
\[z_2 \approx -10.625 + 2.847i\]
Kyun: jama aur tafreeq \(x + iy\) form mein part by part hoti hai; polar form mein in ka koi seedha rule nahi.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos 15^{\circ} \approx 0.9659\) bara aur \(\sin 15^{\circ} \approx 0.2588\) chhota hai; in ko aapas mein na ulat dein.

Part by part jama karein
\[x \approx 6.761 - 10.625 = -3.864\]
\[y \approx -1.812 + 2.847 = 1.035\]
Kyun: real ko real ke saath aur imaginary ko imaginary ke saath jama kiya.

Tasdeeq (check):
Ek dilchasp baat dekhiye: \(165^{\circ} = 345^{\circ} - 180^{\circ}\). Yani \(z_2\) bilkul \(z_1\) ki ulti direction mein hai, aur \(z_2 = -\frac{11}{7}z_1\). Is se ek fori aur exact check milta hai.
\[z_1 + z_2 = z_1 - \dfrac{11}{7}z_1 = -\dfrac{4}{7}z_1\]
\[= -4\,\text{cis}\,345^{\circ} \approx -3.864 + 1.035i\]
Exact jawab: \(-(\sqrt{6} + \sqrt{2}) + (\sqrt{6} - \sqrt{2})i\). Sahi.
Kyun: jab do numbers ulti directions mein hon to jama ka modulus un ki lambaiyon ka farq hota hai: \(11 - 7 = 4\). Bilkul jaise rassa-kashi mein taqatwar team jitna zyada zor lagaye, rassi utna us taraf jaati hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(-1.62 + 12.47i\) deti hai, jo \(z_1 + z_2\) nahin (is ka modulus taqreeban 12.6 hai, jab ke dono numbers ulti directions mein hone ki wajah se \(|z_1 + z_2| = 11 - 7 = 4\) hai). Sahi jawab \(-3.86 + 1.04i\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (ii) If \(z_1 = 7\left(\cos\frac{23\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{23\pi}{12}\right)\) and \(z_2 = 11\left(\cos\frac{11\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{11\pi}{12}\right)\), find \(z_1 - z_2\) and express the result in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh tafreeq (subtraction) hai. Pehle dono numbers ko \(x + iy\) mein badlenge, phir part by part minus karenge. Yahan sab se ahem cheez signs hain: negative number ko minus karna asal mein jama karna hai. Aakhir mein ulti directions wali baat se check karenge.
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(z_1 = 7\,\text{cis}\,\frac{23\pi}{12}\), \(z_2 = 11\,\text{cis}\,\frac{11\pi}{12}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(z_1 - z_2\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): rectangular form mein badal kar minus.

\(z_1\) aur \(z_2\) ko rectangular form mein likhein
\(\frac{23\pi}{12} = 345^{\circ}\) (fourth quadrant: cos plus, sin minus) aur \(\frac{11\pi}{12} = 165^{\circ}\) (second quadrant: cos minus, sin plus); dono ka reference angle \(15^{\circ}\) hai.
\[z_1 = 7(\cos 345^{\circ} + i\sin 345^{\circ})\]
\[z_1 = 7(0.9659 - 0.2588i)\]
\[z_1 \approx 6.761 - 1.812i\]
\[z_2 = 11(\cos 165^{\circ} + i\sin 165^{\circ})\]
\[z_2 = 11(-0.9659 + 0.2588i)\]
\[z_2 \approx -10.625 + 2.847i\]
Kyun: jama aur tafreeq \(x + iy\) form mein part by part hoti hai; polar form mein in ka koi seedha rule nahi.

Part by part minus karein
\[x \approx 6.761 - (-10.625) = 17.386\]
\[y \approx -1.812 - 2.847 = -4.659\]
Kyun: \(-(-10.625) = +10.625\); negative ko minus karna us ko jama karne ke barabar hai.
Dhyan dein: imaginary part mein \(-1.812 - 2.847\) hai, kyunke \(z_2\) ka imaginary part \(+2.847\) hai aur us ke aage minus laga.

Tasdeeq (check):
Ek dilchasp baat dekhiye: \(165^{\circ} = 345^{\circ} - 180^{\circ}\). Yani \(z_2\) bilkul \(z_1\) ki ulti direction mein hai, aur \(z_2 = -\frac{11}{7}z_1\). Is se ek fori aur exact check milta hai.
\[z_1 - z_2 = z_1 + \dfrac{11}{7}z_1 = \dfrac{18}{7}z_1\]
\[= 18\,\text{cis}\,345^{\circ} \approx 17.387 - 4.659i\]
Exact jawab: \(\frac{9(\sqrt{6} + \sqrt{2})}{2} - \frac{9(\sqrt{6} - \sqrt{2})}{2}i\). Sahi.
Kyun: ulti direction wale number ko minus karna usi direction mein jama karne jaisa hai, is liye lambaiyan jama hoti hain: \(7 + 11 = 18\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(-12.69 + 1.01i\) deti hai. Sahi jawab \(17.39 - 4.66i\) hai (modulus \(7 + 11 = 18\)).

blocks.prompt: 5 (iii) If \(z_1 = 7\left(\cos\frac{23\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{23\pi}{12}\right)\) and \(z_2 = 11\left(\cos\frac{11\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{11\pi}{12}\right)\), find \(z_1 \cdot z_2\) and express the result in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh zarb hai, is liye polar form ka product rule seedha lagega: moduli zarb, arguments jama. Plan: \(7 \times 11\), angles ka jama, phir poora chakkar hata kar principal argument, aur standard angle \(150^{\circ}\) ki exact values se \(x + iy\).
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(r_1 = 7\), \(\theta_1 = \frac{23\pi}{12}\); \(r_2 = 11\), \(\theta_2 = \frac{11\pi}{12}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(z_1 z_2\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): \(z_1 z_2 = r_1 r_2\,\text{cis}(\theta_1 + \theta_2)\).

Moduli zarb karein aur arguments jama karein
\[r_1 r_2 = 7 \times 11 = 77\]
\[\dfrac{23\pi}{12} + \dfrac{11\pi}{12} = \dfrac{34\pi}{12} = \dfrac{17\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: product rule: lambaiyan zarb, angles jama. \(\frac{34}{12}\) ko 2 se simplify kar ke \(\frac{17}{6}\) kiya.

Poora chakkar hatayein
\[\dfrac{17\pi}{6} - 2\pi = \dfrac{5\pi}{6}\]
\[z_1 z_2 = 77\,\text{cis}\,\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\]
Kyun: \(2\pi\) ek poora chakkar hai, is se direction nahi badalti. \(\frac{17\pi}{6}\) principal range se bahar tha; \(\frac{5\pi}{6}\) range ke andar hai, yahi principal argument hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\frac{17\pi}{6} - 2\pi = \frac{17\pi}{6} - \frac{12\pi}{6}\); \(2\pi\) ko pehle \(\frac{12\pi}{6}\) likhein, phir minus karein.

Rectangular form
\[\cos\dfrac{5\pi}{6} = -\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}, \ \sin\dfrac{5\pi}{6} = \dfrac{1}{2}\]
\[z_1 z_2 = -\dfrac{77\sqrt{3}}{2} + \dfrac{77}{2}i\]
\[\approx -66.68 + 38.5i\]
Kyun: \(\frac{5\pi}{6} = 150^{\circ}\) second quadrant mein hai (cos negative, sin positive), reference angle \(30^{\circ}\).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(74.64 - 19.25i\) deti hai. Sahi product \(77\,\text{cis}\,\frac{5\pi}{6} = -\frac{77\sqrt{3}}{2} + \frac{77}{2}i \approx -66.68 + 38.5i\) hai.

blocks.prompt: 5 (iv) If \(z_1 = 7\left(\cos\frac{23\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{23\pi}{12}\right)\) and \(z_2 = 11\left(\cos\frac{11\pi}{12} + i\sin\frac{11\pi}{12}\right)\), find \(\frac{z_1}{z_2}\) and express the result in \(x + iy\) form.
blocks.explanation: Yeh taqseem hai: moduli taqseem, arguments minus (pehla minus doosra). Yahan angles ka farq bilkul \(\pi\) nikalta hai, jis ka cos \(-1\) hai; isi minus ko answer key bhool gayi. Plan: \(\frac{7}{11}\), angles ka farq, phir \(\cos\pi\) aur \(\sin\pi\) se \(x + iy\).
steps:
Given (diya gaya hai): \(r_1 = 7\), \(\theta_1 = \frac{23\pi}{12}\); \(r_2 = 11\), \(\theta_2 = \frac{11\pi}{12}\).
To find (maloom karna hai): \(\frac{z_1}{z_2}\), \(x + iy\) form mein.
Method (tareeqa): \(\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{r_1}{r_2}\,\text{cis}(\theta_1 - \theta_2)\).

Moduli taqseem karein aur arguments minus karein
\[\dfrac{r_1}{r_2} = \dfrac{7}{11}\]
\[\dfrac{23\pi}{12} - \dfrac{11\pi}{12} = \dfrac{12\pi}{12} = \pi\]
Kyun: quotient rule. Denominator ek hi (12) hai, is liye sirf upar ke numbers minus kiye: \(23 - 11 = 12\).

Rectangular form
\[\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{7}{11}(\cos\pi + i\sin\pi)\]
\[= \dfrac{7}{11}(-1 + 0i) = -\dfrac{7}{11} + 0i\]
Kyun: \(\cos\pi = -1\), \(\sin\pi = 0\), kyunke \(\pi\) negative real axis ki direction hai.
Dhyan dein: \(\cos\pi\) ki value \(-1\) hai, \(+1\) nahi. Isi wajah se jawab negative hai.

Tasdeeq (check):
Ek dilchasp baat dekhiye: \(165^{\circ} = 345^{\circ} - 180^{\circ}\). Yani \(z_2\) bilkul \(z_1\) ki ulti direction mein hai, aur \(z_2 = -\frac{11}{7}z_1\). Is se ek fori aur exact check milta hai.
\[\dfrac{z_1}{z_2} = \dfrac{z_1}{-\frac{11}{7}z_1} = -\dfrac{7}{11}\]
Sahi. Ulti direction wale numbers ki taqseem hamesha ek negative real number hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Answer key \(\frac{7}{11} + 0i\) deti hai. \(\cos\pi = -1\) hai, is liye sahi jawab \(-\frac{7}{11} + 0i\) hai.
